storyboard.ears: Most people hospitalized with the flu last season had skipped the shot.
Flu sent roughly 710,000 Americans to hospital beds last season, making the season brutally severe.
storyboard.eyes: substance: patients on hospital beds; cause: Data wheels each flu patient in by the bed's handle and parks it in an empty bay
storyboard.evidence: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention | 2024-25 US flu season toll | https://www.cdc.gov/flu-burden/php/data-vis-vac/2024-2025-prevented.html | 2026-10-24

storyboard.ears: Older adults got hit hardest. People 75 and up were hospitalized at nearly five times the overall rate.
storyboard.evidence: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention | Flu hospitalization rate per 100,000 | https://www.cdc.gov/flu-burden/php/data-vis-vac/2024-2025-prevented.html | 2026-10-24

storyboard.ears: Only about one in three hospitalized flu patients had gotten a flu shot. Two in three had skipped it.
storyboard.evidence: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention | Vaccination status of flu hospitalizations | https://www.cdc.gov/flu-burden/php/data-vis-vac/2024-2025-prevented.html | 2026-10-24

storyboard.ears: The shot isn't perfect, but most who landed in the hospital skipped it. Get yours.
